newsitem.title: USA: FGIC qualifies seven issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC qualifies seven issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co. said it has qualified for bond insurance the following seven municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Berkeley USD, Calif., $20 million general obligation bonds.
--Hillman Community Schools, Mich., $8.345 million school building and site bonds.
--Les Cheneaux Comm., Mich., $5.2 million school building and site bonds.
--North Colonie CSD, N.Y., $5 million school district bonds.
--Rotterdam CSD, N.Y., $14.97 million school district bonds.
--Wilson County, Tenn., $4.8 million capital outlay GOs.
